subject: general
question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 4.**
solution:
The correct answer is "**under**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the given sentence, we need to use the preposition "**under**" in the blank.
 
• The preposition means **under **below or lower than something.
 
• We commonly use the preposition under with the phrase pressure "**under pressure**".
 
• Under pressure means when we are under **duress **or **stress **in a given circumstance.
 
 
• **Example**:* She was **under pressure **__to meet the deadline at the office.*
 
 
 
• In the given sentence, it is implied that the athlete did not crumble under a tough situation.
 
• So, we need to use the phrase** under pressure** to complete the meaning of the sentence.

Hence, the correct answer is **option 1**.

**The complete passage is**: Mirabai Chanu, ***(1) the* **Indian weight lifter who recently set a new world record of 119 k in April 2021, has improved her ***(2) ******personal*** best to a total of 205 kg. She has proved that she is stronger ***(3) ******both*** mentally and physically. Chanu did not crumble ***(4) ******unde*r** pressure. She is now full of confidence as she now comes within the ***(5) ******range*** to take the medal in the Olympics.
